description: Create and launch a new campaign for the calling business. Returns the campaign id, name, and dashboard URL. The campaign goes live immediately — no separate publish step.

actions.description: Action IDs the campaign accepts (e.g. ['ig_st'] for an Instagram Story Tag).

businessId.description: The business owning this campaign. Must match the API key's business.

discountType.description: Discount denomination: 'pct' for percentage, 'dol' for dollars off.

discountValue.description: Discount amount. Capped at 100 for pct, 10000 for dol.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the campaign auto-expires. Default 60.

maxCompletions.description: Optional cap on total completions. Null = no cap.

name: createCampaign
